Fresh unpinned-latest getLiquidationConfig observation resolves liquidatableManager 0x70139002b9b5ee3f0631840b34ca03747614b1de; exact address source-service grade is preserved in evidence, not asserted perpetual runtime identity.

liquidateUsers transfers full repayAmountLimit of 6-decimal USDC from msg.sender using existing allowance, processes each oracle-unhealthy supplied account, burns its debt and transfers corresponding 18-decimal wstETH supply-ledger credits (not immediate wstETH cash) to caller with configured bonus. No user minimum supply received, exchange-rate limit or deadline; oracle, supply/debt accounting, rounding, mutable bonus and active strategies can produce loss.

Ingress validateLiquidateUsers checks function disable and sanctions, not a role installation; position/snapshot updates and lender repayment are fixed protocol interactions. No callbacks, caller-selected manager, opaque data or new on-behalf permission is passed. Batch size affects gas; active lender/ingress/manager upgrades and pauses can revert. Source manager internally approves its lender from protocol funds, not a wallet approval capability.

Resolver/factory/accounting ledger and possible configured base-to-USDT conversion are protocol dependencies, not caller-selected executors or opaque calldata. writeOff accrues interest and requires oracle allowLiquidations. Only debt>100*oracle-valued collateral triggers writeoff; otherwise returns false without payout. It deletes debt, redistributes that debt proportionately to remaining free/paid borrowers and sends all target recorded collateral to to. No Coin payment is charged by this method.
